about: Heartbeats and AI budgets per role. Only the founder edits this file (the budget gate). enabled: the role wakes on its cron schedule (UTC) as a cloud scheduled task; run `python tools/heartbeat.py plan` for the prompts. monthly_budget_usd: AI usage cost per calendar month (UTC), warned at 80% and stopped at 100%; null means not set, and a role without a budget never runs a heartbeat. company.monthly_budget_usd caps all roles together: every run checks it too, with the same 80% warning and 100% stop. Costs are API-equivalent prices per million tokens, measured from session transcripts; fallback_run_usd is recorded when a run can't be measured. autopilot: when enabled, the agents workflow starts a run for every role whose heartbeat is on and that has a ticket ready, straight after each handoff, and the chief of staff is given a planning ticket whenever the current stage or the goals have work no ticket covers (plan_every_hours apart); max_runs_per_day caps all runs together, max_parallel how many run at once, models the model per role (default sonnet). It needs the CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN (or ANTHROPIC_API_KEY) repository secret; `python tools/autopilot.py gaps` shows what it would plan.
